title: New Reactome Publication
body:
##  New Reactome Publication 

A new Reactome paper titled “Functional Interaction Network Construction and Analysis for Disease Discovery” has been published in [Methods in Molecular Biology](<http://link.springer.com/protocol/10.1007%2F978-1-4939-6783-4_11>). More publications from the [Reactome Team](</about/team>) can be found [here](<https://reactome.org/community/publications>).
